about_the_game:
Hello there! This is a sci-fi RPG indie game :D

·Sci-fi Mystery Adventure

Set against a modern sci-fi backdrop infused with philosophical contemplation, the game invites players to explore and gain insight into the entire world.

A second moon appears in the sky, a massive research facility hidden underground, recurring dreams, and eerie colleagues.

Should you listen to the voice in your head, or trust your own judgment based on what you see and hear?

————————————————————————————————————————————————

·Story Background Introduction

A global flood has devastated coastal research facilities, and players arrive at a post-disaster reconstruction project site.

Your friend, who helped you get the job at the project, suddenly brings you a chilling piece of news.

————————————————————————————————————————————————

· Gameplay Introduction

Side-scrolling movement

Branching dialogue options

Play as the God rolling the dice

By taking on the roles of different characters, uncover the truth behind the mystery and shape the story of this world through your choices.

————————————————————————————————————————————————

·Characters:

Multi-Character Role-Playing

Control more than one character to gain a comprehensive and three-dimensional understanding of the entire story.

Bu Guai

The protagonist of the game, Bu Guai, is an average individual who struggled to find a job due to the economic downturn after the disaster. She was later introduced by He Xi, a senior executive at the project's headquarters, to work as a technician at the construction site. As for why He Xi treats Bu Guai so well, explaining it solely with charisma seems a bit far-fetched.

Chen Qingshan

After the great flood, the online records of many people were destroyed, and Chen Qingshan was among them. Almost no one knows what his qualifications are, yet he managed to secure this job quite effortlessly.

He Xi

A leader at the project's headquarters, He Xi is somehow very familiar with Bu Guai and easily became friends with her, as if they had been friends for a lifetime.

————————————————————————————————————————————————
